channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump weighs ‘massive attack’ on Iran
item.description: Trump says he is considering a ‘massive attack’, as Iran's Araghchi says 'mindless aggression' won't help a deal.

item.title: Two Palestinians killed as Israel intensifies strikes on Gaza City
item.description: Two Palestinians were killed and several others injured in a new wave of Israeli airstrikes on Gaza City.

item.title: How the Houthi Red Sea blockade will impact the world
item.description: The Houthis' blockade of Bab al-Mandeb threatens a vital global trade route.

item.title: US war on Iran: The $110 billion price tag
item.description: America's war on Iran has cost the US nearly $110 billion. Now, the Trump administration wants another $67 billion.

item.title: Trump warns of largest strikes on Iran yet as Tehran lashes out across Gulf
item.description: The US president's threat comes after another day of Iranian attacks on Bahrain, Kuwait and Jordan.

item.title: US-Saudi nuclear deal hinges on normalisation with Israel
item.description: President Trump said a proposed US-Saudi civilian nuclear deal is subject to Saudi Arabia joining the Abraham Accords

item.title: Indian activist Wangchuk ends 26-day hunger strike over exam paper leaks
item.description: ⁠Sonam ⁠Wangchuk says he ended his fast to demand education minister's resignation 'in view of possible violence'.

item.title: Minnesota man who killed Democratic lawmaker sentenced to life in US prison
item.description: Judge says that long sentence is merited for slaying of state Democratic lawmaker Melissa Hortman and her husband Mark.

item.title: Journalist killed in Mexico after years of exposing corruption
item.description: Mexican journalist Alejandro Leyva Aguilar was shot dead while eating at a street food stall in Oaxaca.

item.title: Children wounded in Israeli strike on Khan Younis
item.description: Children were rushed to hospital after an Israeli strike hit a tent sheltering displaced people in Khan Younis.
